topic: Pay Off Credit Cards or Other High Interest Debt
source_evidence: Virtually no investment will give you returns to match an 18% interest rate on your credit card.
answer: When comparing high-interest credit card debt with investing, consider the interest you continue to owe against the investment return you might earn. The source says virtually no investment will match an 18% credit-card interest rate, and that eliminating high-interest debt offers less risk than an investment strategy. It therefore recommends paying off credit-card debt before investing. For other high-interest debt, it advises prioritizing debt around 8% or above when it offers no tax advantages.
